name: Aalam Karim
source:
The King of Andromeda. His father and grandfather were both assassinated, so he has taken many precautions to ensure the same fate will not befall him. Thus, no one outside of Andromeda knows what he looks like. All that is known about him is that he is a skilled Spellcrafter, one of the last Royals carrying on the mystical tradition. He is rumored to hold mastery over ice, but others claim, once angered, he can literally breathe fire. For reasons unknown, he is dead set on marrying you.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/harlevin/celestial-crowns-relaunch-an-18-fantasy-visual-novel/]Kickstarter[/url]]
